name: sim3d
about: 3D physics simulations you can rotate (cannon-es + Three.js), z up, meters and seconds
api: Pix.sim3d(el, {bodies:[{shape:"sphere"|"box"|"cylinder", size:[…], pos:[x,y,z], vel:[…], mass, bounce, color, label, fixed}], springs:[{a, b | anchor:[x,y,z], length, stiffness, rod}], gravity:9.8, seconds}) — Pause/Replay/Spin; shows time, speed, height; point at bodies by label
